tropic01_schnorr_roadmap.product_gate: Direct TROPIC01 Schnorr/BIP-340 signing requires a public API or written vendor integration path before it can replace ESP32-S3 host MCU signing.

security_requirements: Rev A is a USB-C bus-powered connected hardware wallet with no battery subsystem.
Wireless must be disabled or excluded in firmware and production policy; if an ESP32-S3 module with antenna is used, do not claim physical RF absence.
Support ESP32-S3 secure boot and signed firmware verification before production signing.
Support ESP32-S3 flash encryption or equivalent persistent-secret protection before storing a Nostr secret.
Expose a documented debug-lock, recovery, and provisioning policy before production use.
TROPIC01 is mandatory in Rev A as a secure element for secure channel, TRNG, device authenticity, pairing key lifecycle, MAC-and-Destroy PIN attempts, and key wrapping or unlock material.
TROPIC01 direct Schnorr/BIP-340 signing is a future vendor-roadmap path, not a current Rev A assumption.
The Rev A BIP-340 signing engine is the ESP32-S3 host MCU unless a future TROPIC01 public API or written vendor integration path proves non-exportable Schnorr support.
TROPIC01 reset/recovery must use controlled power cycling rather than an assumed dedicated reset pin.
The TROPIC01 SPI bus must be separable from display traffic in firmware and layout review.
review_requirements: Provide a local display large enough to show raw event kind, signer author, complete content, complete tags, request id, approval_digest, and approval status.
Provide physical approve, reject, and navigation controls with distinct tactile actions.
Require explicit approval for each sign_event request unless a later scoped automation policy has been separately accepted.
Reject signing when the displayed request id does not match the pending request.
Reject signing when the displayed approval_digest does not match the pending request review.
Do not treat touch-only controls as final approve or reject consent for production hardware-wallet claims.
identity_policy_requirements: Reference the shared nsealr-account-descriptor-v0 route custom_hardware_wallet.
Use custody custom_hardware_persistent for persistent-secret hardware-wallet descriptors.
Use policy-manual-only-persistent-device as the default policy profile.
Reference policy-scoped-automation-daily-use only after firmware, provisioning, storage, review, signed-output gates, and a device-approved policy-change proposal are accepted.
Manual-only mode must remain available even after scoped automation is later supported.
Account descriptors and policy metadata must remain secretless; private keys, nsec values, seed words, and pairing secrets must not be stored by companion descriptors.
notes: This is a requirements scaffold for the first custom persistent-secret wallet Rev A, not a routed PCB.
USB data transport means this board is connected/no-wireless; QR-only stateless vaults remain the offline transport line.
The Waveshare 1.44 inch ST7735S display remains a compact candidate, not a locked display requirement.
The TROPIC01 Arduino Shield, USB DevKit, and Mini Board are reference/prototype inputs for this family.
TROPIC01 part selection should prefer current recommended or vendor-confirmed parts, not deprecated T101/T103-era assumptions.
